breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 从“提心吊胆终身服药/等待突发”走向“一次修复致病根源”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 睡梦与突发危象的实时监测预警
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 在数分钟至数小时黄金窗到来前，提前发出异常信号
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 以遗传性易栓症、急性肺栓塞、主动脉夹层、恶性心律失常和脑出血为代表的急症，平时毫无征兆，往往在睡梦中或静息状态下几分钟内危及生命——家人根本来不及反应。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 需要发展连续无创可穿戴微循环/血氧/心电多模态传感器、血液微凝血活性快速试纸，结合 AI 在异常触发前几小时识别微血栓与高危信号并立即叫醒预警。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把“几分钟决定生死”的抢救窗口拓宽成“几小时可救回”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 对急性心梗、脑梗死、脓毒性休克、急性肝衰竭与热射病而言，哪怕送到急诊室，微血管再灌注损伤、细胞因子风暴和不可逆线粒体坏死仍会在短时间内夺走生命。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 急性多器官微循环级联动力学建模、急诊快速炎症/凝血表型分型、老药新用紧急器官保护筛选。

master.definition_en: A condition characterized by a chronically swollen limb, often a leg with stasis dermatitis and ulcerations. This syndrome can appear soon after phlebitis or years later. Postphlebitic syndrome is the result of damaged or incompetent venous valves in the limbs. Distended, tortuous varicose veins are usually present. Leg pain may occur after long period of standing.

curated.lethality_detail_zh: 人类已知倍增时间最短、生长最快的恶性肿瘤（Ki-67接近100%，肿瘤体积可在24–48小时内翻倍）！特征性携带MYC基因易位t(8;14)；极易并发致命性肿瘤溶解综合征(TLS)、肠套叠/肠穿孔及骨髓/中枢神经系统浸润，未及时治疗数日至数周内即可死亡。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 虽然来势极其凶猛，但对短疗程、高强度免疫化疗极其敏感！儿童及年轻成人经利妥昔单抗联合CODOX-M/IVAC或DA-EPOCH-R方案治疗，早期治愈率高达85%–95%，即使晚期高危组长期治愈率仍达65%–80%；救治成败的关键在于“确诊后数天内启动治疗并严防肿瘤溶解综合征”。

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 1) 【极高危肿瘤溶解综合征(TLS)急救铁律】伯基特淋巴瘤在化疗前即可发生自发TLS，首次化疗后6–72小时内大量肿瘤细胞崩解释放高钾、高磷、高尿酸，可致室颤猝死及急性肾衰竭！必须提前24小时入住监护病房：给予充分静脉水化(3000ml/m2/d)、首选拉布立酶(Rasburicase，禁用于G6PD缺乏症/蚕豆病患者，可改用非布司他/别嘌醇)、每4–6小时查血钾/磷/钙/尿酸/肌酐，必要时紧急CRRT血液透析，并采用低剂量COP预处理方案平滑减瘤后再上全量化疗; 2) 回盲部肿块诱发急性肠套叠或肠穿孔：立即禁食抗感染并急诊外科干预。

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 1) DA-EPOCH-R方案在成人伯基特淋巴瘤多中心研究中取得与高毒性CODOX-M/IVAC相当的85%以上治愈率，且显著降低老年及HIV患者治疗相关死亡率; 2) 针对极其难治的复发伯基特淋巴瘤，CD19/CD22双靶点CAR-T与CD20×CD3双抗(格菲妥单抗)正开展挽救性临床研究; 3) 2024–2025年全基因组研究进一步揭示ID3/TCF3/CCND3通路协同MYC驱动机制。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 一旦一线强化疗后早期复发或原发耐药，目前尚无任何高有效率二线方案，复发后中位生存不足3个月; 2) 基层医院对高肿瘤负荷TLS认识不足导致早期死于高钾/急性肾衰; 3) 缺乏直接靶向MYC癌蛋白的获批小分子药物。

master.definition_en: Chromosome 16p13.3deletion syndrome is a chromosome abnormality that can affect many parts of the body. People with this condition are missing a small piece (deletion) of chromosome 16 at a location designated p13.3. Although once thought to be a severe form of Rubinstein-Taybi syndrome, it is now emerging as a unique syndrome. Signs and symptoms may include failure to thrive, hypotonia (reduced muscle tone), short stature, microcephaly (unusually small head), characteristic facial features, mild to moderate intellectual disability, organ anomalies (i.e. heart and/or kidney problems), and vulnerability to infections. Chromosome testing of both parents can provide information about whether the deletion was inherited. In most cases, parents do not have any chromosome abnormalities. However, sometimes one parent has a balanced translocation where a piece of a chromosome has broken off and attached to another one with no gain or loss of genetic material. The balanced translocation normally does not cause signs or symptoms, but it increases the risk for having a child with a chromosome abnormality like a deletion. Treatment is based on the signs and symptoms present in each person.To learn more about chromosome abnormalities in general, view our GARD fact sheet on Chromosome Disorders.

master.definition_en: Primary orthostatic hypotension is a rare type of orthostatic hypotension. It is not a disease per se, but a condition caused by several disorders that affect a specific part of the autonomic nervous system, such as multiple system atrophy, young-onset Parkinson's disease, pure autonomic failure, dopamine beta-hydroxylase deficiency, familial dysautonomia, and pure autonomic failure among others. The autonomic nervous system is the part of the nervous system that regulates certain involuntary body functions such as heart rate, blood pressure, sweating, and bowel and bladder control. Orthostatic hypotension is a form of low blood pressure that happens when standing-up from sitting or lying down. Common symptoms may include dizziness, lightheadedness, generalized weakness, leg buckling, nausea, blurry vision, fatigue, and headaches. Additional symptoms can include chest pain (angina), head and neck pain (often affecting neck and shoulders with a coat hanger distribution), decline in cognitive functioning such as difficulty concentrating, temporary loss of consciousness or “blackout”. Some people with primary orthostatic hypotension may also have high blood pressure when lying down. The treatment depends upon several factors including the specific underlying cause including The treatment depends upon several factors including the specific underlying cause and may include physical counter-maneuvers like lying down, sitting down, squatting clenching buttocks, leg crossing, and support garment and medication.

Symptoms are variable and can include palpitations, tachypnea, dyspnea, chest pain, fatigue, and cyanosis. master.definition_en: HHV-6 encephalitis refers to inflammation of the brain due to an infection with human herpesvirus 6. People who have undergone allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplantation are at an increased risk for developing HHV-6 encephalitis, particularly when umbilical cord blood stem cells are used. People with immune system disorders may also be at an increased risk for developing this infection. breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 从“提心吊胆终身服药/等待突发”走向“一次修复致病根源”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推进高精度体内 CRISPR 碱基/先导编辑、低免疫原性肝/神经靶向病毒载体（AAV）与脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）递送，以及患者自体干细胞精准修复移植，让身体自己恢复生产正常蛋白。

master.name_en: Genetic intestinal disease due to fat malabsorption

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 跨生理屏障递送与 RNA / 蛋白稳态重塑
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把药真正送进大脑、心脏与深层致密病灶
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 神经退行性疾病（渐冻症 ALS、阿尔茨海默病、帕金森）、胶质母细胞瘤与纤维化器官病往往不是没发现靶点，而是大分子药进不去血脑屏障，或普通小分子误伤全身。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 突破跨血脑屏障转运体载体、GalNAc-siRNA / ASO 精密肝脏与中枢基因沉默调控、靶向蛋白降解嵌合体（PROTAC）及虚拟细胞药效预测技术。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 可穿屏障肽/纳米载体生成式设计、RNA 序列稳定与毒性预测、多组学虚拟细胞扰动响应仿真。

master.name_en: Isolated complex neurodevelopmental disorder without intellectual disability or autism spectrum disorder
master.definition_en: A rare neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by the combination of at least two neurodevelopmental disorders, including specific learning disorder (e.g., impairment in reading, written expression, or mathematics), motor disorder (e.g. developmental coordination disorder, stereotypic movement disorder, tic disorder), communication disorder (e.g., developmental language disorder, speech sound disorder, childhood-onset fluency disorder, social/pragmatic communication disorder), attention deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADD/ADHD) and other specified or unspecified neurodevelopmental disorders as defined in DSM-5 or ICD-11. Patients don't reach the criteria of an autism spectrum disorder diagnosis, do not have intellectual disability or any dysmorphic features or congenital anomalies.
